channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The period's clearest wins are infrastructure capital flowing to water systems: the Fiscal Oversight Board cleared $127M for AAA capital projects including lead-line replacement, USDA approved a $7.5M loan for Toa Baja stormwater work, PRASA committed $1.8M to accelerate leak repairs, and GEM data show entrepreneurship stabilizing despite financing constraints. The dominant risk is energy reliability: the Oversight Board revoked PREPA's $5.9B emergency generation contract with Power Expectations after its named technical partner disavowed involvement, leaving the capacity gap unaddressed. A worsening water crisis (180,000+ households on rationing) has drawn a 25-member congressional push for a federal disaster declaration, with roughly $30B in prior disaster recovery funds still undisbursed.
